subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: Should durable memory v1 make provenance a schema-level invariant in the active memory backend before promotion/retrieval/review flows land, or keep current lightweight citation/wiki provenance and defer a formal model?
rationale: This chooses durable storage shape, plugin boundary ownership, merge/edit lineage semantics, and security posture; automation cannot safely pick that product contract.

options.title: Schema-level provenance first
options.body: Define source refs, multi-source lineage, and merge/edit preservation as part of the v1 memory schema before broader write/review surfaces land.

options.title: Keep lightweight citations
options.body: Treat current path#line citations and wiki evidence as enough for now, leaving durable memory provenance as a later redesign.

options.title: Move provenance to wiki layer
options.body: Keep active memory lean and make Memory Wiki the provenance-rich belief layer, accepting that promotion/retrieval memory entries remain lighter-weight.

recommendation.title: Schema-level provenance first
recommendation.body: Define source refs, multi-source lineage, and merge/edit preservation as part of the v1 memory schema before broader write/review surfaces land.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core and Memory Wiki history makes vincentkoc the strongest routing candidate for the product contract decision.
